messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Incident #4821 auto-closed but follow-up requested — customers saw 502s for ~11m, error spikes from svc-ingest in us-west-2. Please schedule an after-action and confirm chair/scribe. https://redwood.inc/incident/4821 :rotating_light:
alex chen: saw the alert, thanks. confirmed impact to a handful of clients (billing ingest). we should get a short async writeup then 30m sync. who can chair? :calendar:
maria gomez: I can do the writeup + notes. quick note on impact: ~120 failed requests/min at the peak, retries masked it for some customers but one enterprise saw a full outage for 8m. I have logs + initial RCA in the incident doc. :clipboard:
samir patel: I can chair the 30m sync at 15:30 PT today if that works. otherwise tomorrow morning works. assigning scribe? @june li? :hand:
june li: happy to scribe. I'll capture action items and create follow-up tickets in JIRA. can someone drop the calendar invite? :white_check_mark:
ops-coordinator: dropping invite now. proposed window: today 15:30–16:00 PT (UTC-7). invite: "4821 after-action huddle — chair: samir, scribe: june". adding incident doc link + agenda. :spiral_calendar:
ops-coordinator: ```Invite details:
Title: 4821 after-action huddle — chair: samir patel, scribe: june li
When: 2025-06-30 15:30 PT (30m)
Where: #incidents VC / Zoom link
Agenda:
- Quick timeline (5m)
- RCA summary (10m)
- Action items & owners (10m)
- Customer comms next steps (5m)
Docs: https://redwood.inc/incident/4821```
alex chen: works for me. pls cc @maria gomez and @eng-lead on the invite for visibility.
maria gomez: added a short customer impact summary to the doc, flagging billing-ops as FYI; cc'd @support-team.
samir patel: confirmed — I'll chair. I'll focus on mitigation steps we took and the kernel of the root cause (KV cache evictions during scaling event). want migration plan discussed as an action item.
june li: noted. I'll create the JIRA epic during the meeting and link action items. can someone paste any customer contacts we need to notify?
maria gomez: billing-enterprise@example.com — raised a ticket already. also need to notify partner APM team that saw correlated traces.
alex chen: after-action deliverables: 1) short post-incident summary (maria) 2) Jira epic & tickets (june) 3) quantize mitigation plan (samir) 4) follow-up customer email draft (alex) — owners set.
ops-coordinator: invite posted and RSVPs open. adding 1:1 follow-up slot on calendar tomorrow for any unresolved action items: 10:00 PT.
incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: 20m before meeting — channel ping + DM to chair/scribe.
samir patel: quick pre-meeting ask: can eng-releases share the deploy log that coincided with the scaling event? @alex chen any pointers to the deploy id?
alex chen: deploy id: deploy-2025-06-30-09 (sha: a1b2c3). logs are in the incident doc under "artifacts". I'll paste key grep commands in the thread now.
alex chen: ```grep -i "scale" /logs/deploy-2025-06-30-09.log | tail -n 50
# yields the autoscaler notices around 09:42:16 UTC```
june li: perfect. i'll prep the meeting notes template: 1) timeline 2) decisions 3) action items 4) owners & due dates.
maria gomez: can someone who owns the customer email draft take it and loop in legal for any sensitive wording? alex offered — thanks.
alex chen: i'll draft and ping legal. plan to send within 24h after we lock the summary.
ops-coordinator: RSVP counts: 6 confirmed (samir, june, alex, maria, eng-lead, support-rep). if anyone else wants to join, ping here.
eng-lead: will join to approve any infra changes and sign off on rollout plan.
june li: recording enabled; i'll attach the recording link to the incident doc and to the Jira epic after meeting.
samir patel: thanks all. see you at 15:30 PT.
incident-bot: MEETING REMINDER: 20 minutes to 4821 after-action huddle (chair: samir patel, scribe: june li). This channel will be updated with notes and action items after the meeting."
